overview_description.description:
Dataglade is the most powerful financial research terminal available, powered by AI.

Our AI unlocks undiscovered alpha while saving analysts hours of research time everyday. It extracts previously-overlooked insights, writes memos, and builds complex financial models from 1+ million financial filings, on demand, with source citations.

Meanwhile, our terminal provides complete data on 48,000+ companies worldwide, including financial statements, earnings transcripts, analyst estimates, options activity, and more.
